name: OpenMAIC
description: Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom — Get an immersive, multi-agent learning experience in just one click
one_liner: A tool that turns a single prompt into a full interactive online course — slides, quizzes, and activities — built and run by AI automatically.
buyer: An independent online course creator or corporate trainer who wants to launch a polished interactive course quickly without hiring instructional designers or developers.
business_use_cases: A corporate L&D team generates onboarding or compliance training courses from existing internal documents in a fraction of the usual time.
An independent educator turns their expertise into an interactive paid course and sells it on their own site instead of a generic PDF or video.
A tutoring startup offers personalized, AI-generated practice courses per student topic weakness, sold as a subscription.

money_ideas.idea: Run a hosted SaaS version and charge per course generated or per active learner seat.
Sell a 'white-label course generator' to corporate training vendors who resell it under their own brand.

steal_this: Stand up a hosted instance this weekend, pick one high-demand niche (e.g. 'AI literacy for HR teams'), and sell finished interactive courses directly to companies.
